source_note: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation 8-K12B, event 2026-07-01: each share of ExxonMobil common stock outstanding (other than treasury shares, cancelled) was automatically exchanged for one share of ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation common stock.

BlackRock, Inc. (New BlackRock) 8-K12B, event 2024-10-01: each share of Old BlackRock common stock issued and outstanding (other than treasury shares, cancelled) was converted automatically into one share of New BlackRock common stock.
APA Corporation 8-K12B, event 2021-03-01: each outstanding share of Apache common stock was automatically converted into one share of APA common stock with the same rights.
Alphabet Inc. 8-K12B, event 2015-10-02: each share of each class of Google stock automatically converted into an equivalent corresponding share of Alphabet stock.
The Walt Disney Company (New Disney) 8-K12B, Merger Effective Date 2019-03-20: each share of Old Disney common stock was converted into one share of Disney stock of the same class.

Cigna Corporation (New Cigna) 8-K12B, event 2018-12-20: each issued and outstanding share of Cigna common stock was converted automatically into one share of New Cigna common stock (Express Scripts holders received 0.2434 of a share plus cash; not this listing).
Xerox Holdings Corporation 8-K12B, event 2019-07-31: each outstanding share of Xerox common stock automatically converted into one share of Holdings common stock.
Broadcom Inc. 8-K12B, event 2018-04-04: all issued ordinary shares of Broadcom-Singapore were exchanged on a one-for-one basis for shares of common stock of Broadcom-Delaware.
Bunge Global SA 8-K12G3, event 2023-11-01: Bunge Global issued one Common Share in exchange, on a one-for-one basis, for each issued and outstanding Bunge Bermuda common share.

Pinnacle Financial Partners (New Pinnacle) 8-K12B, event 2026-01-01: each share of Legacy Pinnacle common stock was converted into the right to receive one share of New Pinnacle common stock (Synovus holders received 0.5237; not this listing).

Viper Energy (New Viper) 8-K12B, event 2025-08-18: each share of Former Viper Class A common stock was cancelled and automatically converted into one share of New Viper Class A common stock (Sitio holders received 0.4855; not this listing).
Core Laboratories Inc. 8-K12B, event 2023-05-01: Core Lab N.V. common shares were exchanged on a one-for-one basis; former holders hold one share of Core Lab Delaware for each.
Noble Corporation plc 8-K12B, event 2022-09-30: each Noble Cayman ordinary share was converted into one class A ordinary share of the Company.
QuidelOrtho Corporation 8-K12B, event 2022-05-27: each Quidel share was converted into the right to receive one QuidelOrtho share (Ortho holders received shares and cash; not this listing).
Northwest Natural Holding Company 8-K12B, event 2018-10-01: each outstanding share of NW Natural common stock converted into one share of NW Holdings common stock.
NorthWestern Energy Group 8-K12G3, event 2023-10-02: each share of Old NWE stock automatically converted into an equivalent corresponding share of New NWE stock.
Southwest Gas Holdings 8-K12B, event 2016-12-28: each share of Old SWG common stock automatically converted into an equivalent corresponding share of SWG Holdings common stock.
